name: TravelBookingAmendmentDesk
tagline: Change, cancel and refund requests quoted by the fare rule – before they turn into ADMs.
description: After-sales desk for travel agencies and TMCs in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: fare-rule penalties and refunds, live quotes, SLA and supplier deadlines, supplier confirmations and ticket/EMD numbers, ADM risk scoring, a workflow board and a deadline agenda, with Power Fx outputs and events.
features: Fare-rule categories (change fee / refund fee / not permitted) in a simple ';' list
Live quote: penalty + fare difference + agency fee, residual warnings
Refund calculation incl. taxes-only refunds on non-refundable fares
ADM risk score with reasons (waived penalties, refunds above rule, missing ticket/EMD or confirmation)
SLA due = received + SLA hours capped by the supplier deadline
Workflow with allowed steps and required confirmation / ticket / waiver / reason
Drag-and-drop board that lights up allowed steps
Deadline agenda: supplier deadlines, SLA due and departures
Bulk move, assign, export and delete with undo
Phone layout with bottom tab bar
